title: PUT /api/files/<app>/<path> body
description: Exactly one of mtime (the modified time you read: the file must still have it) or create: true (the file must not exist yet). For an image, also "encoding": "base64" with content in base64; for .md and .json, no encoding.

encoding.description: Required for images (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif, .webp), not allowed for .md and .json.
